title: How billing works
renews: Every plan renews automatically each month at the price shown above, plus any applicable tax, until you cancel. Each renewal is charged to your payment method on file.
switch: If you already have a subscription, changing plans takes effect right away and the price difference is prorated on your next invoice.
cancel: You can cancel at any time. Cancelling stops future renewals, and you keep access until the end of the period you have already paid for.
confirmation: After you subscribe we email you a confirmation that repeats these terms.
